title: Loon's Retreat 30A
meta_description: Find the perfect 30A, FL vacation rental at “Loon's Retreat 30A”, a luxury 5-bed, 5.5-bath vacation rental. Ideal for 11 guests, this home offers a Private Pool & Spa, Elevator & Golf Cart for your enjoyment. Book your memorable stay now!
description_expanded: Home Highlights -Private Heated Pool & Hot Tub (Pool can be heated for an additional $50 per day from October 1 - May 1) -Elevator -6 Seater Golf Cart Included -6 Adult Bikes -New Construction -Deeded Beach Access Welcome to 28 Loon Lake, a newly built sanctuary where contemporary design meets the effortless charm of coastal living. Designed and furnished by Bird Dog Design Company and crafted by Cogent Building Group, this home rests along the tranquil west end of 30A with private deeded beach access, offering a perfect balance of sophistication and seaside serenity. The heart of the home is an open-concept living space with soaring ceilings, expansive windows, and an abundance of natural light that enhances every detail. A gourmet kitchen flows seamlessly into the dining and living areas, complemented by a sleek wet bar that sets the stage for relaxed gatherings or elegant evenings. Thoughtful finishes, layered textures, and designer lighting create an atmosphere that is both stylish and welcoming. With five beautifully appointed bedrooms, including a custom bunk room, this retreat offers flexible accommodations for families and groups alike. Spa-inspired bathrooms, adorned with intricate tile work and modern fixtures, provide a touch of luxury and tranquility throughout. Outdoors, a private pool invites sun-drenched afternoons or peaceful morning dips, surrounded by lush landscaping that enhances the home’s sense of seclusion. Just steps away, sugar-white sands and emerald waters await, completing the quintessential 30A experience. 28 Loon Lake is more than a beach house, it’s a destination in itself, blending architectural elegance with the warmth and ease of coastal living for an unforgettable Gulf Coast escape. Sleeping Arrangement -First Floor Twin over King Bunkroom, Shared bathroom, Shower/Tub Combo -Second Floor King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower Only 1/2 bath -Third Floor Master King Bedroom, Private Bathroom w/ Soaking Tub and Shower King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower Only King Bedroom w/ Shared Bathroom, Shower Only
